medLen = input(30, "Medium Length", 20, 50, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Length", 40, 90, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Range Length", 40, 90, 1)
compThresh = input(0.7, "Compression Ratio Threshold", 0.3, 0.95, 0.05)
bullThresh = input(0.2, "Bullish Skew Flip Level", -0.5, 0.9, 0.1)
bearThresh = input(-0.2, "Bearish Skew Flip Level", -0.9, 0.5, 0.1)

ret = (close - close[1]) / (close[1] + 0.000000001)
fastVol = stdev(ret, fastLen)
medVol = stdev(ret, medLen)
slowVol = stdev(ret, slowLen)
avgVol = (fastVol + medVol + slowVol) / 3
hh = highest(high, skewLen)
ll = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = hh - ll + 0.000000001
skew = ((close - ll) / rng - 0.5) * 2
spread = fastVol - slowVol
compressed = fastVol < medVol * compThresh and fastVol < slowVol * compThresh
crossUp = crossover(fastVol, medVol)
wasComp = compressed[1] or compressed[2] or compressed[3] or compressed[4] or compressed[5]
expansion = crossUp and wasComp

var expBar = -10000
if expansion {
  expBar := bar_index
}
barsSinceExp = bar_index - expBar
bullFlip = skew > bullThresh and skew[1] <= bullThresh
bearFlip = skew < bearThresh and skew[1] >= bearThresh
inWindow = barsSinceExp <= 2
buySig = inWindow and bullFlip
sellSig = inWindow and bearFlip

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if compressed {
  bgcolor("#1a2a3a")
}

plot(spread, "Spread", "#33aaff", 1, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#ffcc33", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot(fastVol, "Fast Vol", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot3d(avgVol, "Term Structure", "manifold", "#33aaff", "separate")
plot3d(fastVol, "Fast Spine", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate")
plot3d(spread, "Spread Impulse", "bars3d", "#ffcc33", "separate")

ch1 = input(20, "Ch1 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(100, "Ch5 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
thicknessBase = input(1.0, "Thickness Base", 0.5, 5.0, 0.1)
thicknessFactor = input(0.05, "Thickness Factor", 0.01, 0.2, 0.01)
buyThreshold = input(60, "Buy Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
sellThreshold = input(40, "Sell Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = (close - open) * 0.5
c1raw = ch1 + drift
c2raw = ch2 + drift
c3raw = ch3 + drift
c4raw = ch4 + drift
c5raw = ch5 + drift
C1 = min(max(c1raw, 0), 100)
C2 = min(max(c2raw, 0), 100)
C3 = min(max(c3raw, 0), 100)
C4 = min(max(c4raw, 0), 100)
C5 = min(max(c5raw, 0), 100)
H1 = C1 * 1.0
H2 = C2 * 1.0
H3 = C3 * 1.0
H4 = C4 * 1.0
H5 = C5 * 1.0
AVG = (C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + C5) / 5
W = thicknessBase + (AVG * thicknessFactor)
tiltUp = H5 > H1
tiltDown = H5 < H1
buyRaw = crossover(AVG, buyThreshold) and tiltUp
sellRaw = crossunder(AVG, sellThreshold) and tiltDown
satNow = C1 >= 100 or C2 >= 100 or C3 >= 100 or C4 >= 100 or C5 >= 100
lossNow = C1 <= 0 or C2 <= 0 or C3 <= 0 or C4 <= 0 or C5 <= 0
satEdge = satNow and not satNow[1]
lossEdge = lossNow and not lossNow[1]
midCross = crossover(AVG, 50) or crossunder(AVG, 50)
alertRaw = satEdge or lossEdge or midCross
var lastBuy = -1000.0
var lastSell = -1000.0
var lastAlert = -1000.0
buySig = buyRaw and (bar_index - lastBuy > 20)
sellSig = sellRaw and (bar_index - lastSell > 20)
alertSig = alertRaw and (bar_index - lastAlert > 20) and not buySig and not sellSig

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 2, "separate")
  lastBuy := bar_index
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 2, "separate")
  lastSell := bar_index
}
if alertSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Alert", "diamond", "#ffdd00")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Alert3D", "diamond", "#ffdd00", markerSize, 3, "separate")
  lastAlert := bar_index
}

plot(H1, "H1 Cyl1", "#ff4477", 1)
plot(H2, "H2 Cyl2", "#ff9900", 1)
plot(H3, "H3 Cyl3", "#ffdd00", 1)
plot(H4, "H4 Cyl4", "#88dd44", 1)
plot(H5, "H5 Cyl5", "#22cc88", 1)
plot(AVG, "AVG Spline", "#33ccff", W)
plot(W, "Thickness W", "#cc88ff", 1)
hline(buyThreshold, "#22cc88")
hline(sellThreshold, "#ff4477")
hline(50, "#888888")
plot3d(H1, "Cyl1", "bars3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 0)
plot3d(H2, "Cyl2", "bars3d", "#ff9900", "separate", 1)
plot3d(H3, "Cyl3", "bars3d", "#ffdd00", "separate", 2)
plot3d(H4, "Cyl4", "bars3d", "#88dd44", "separate", 3)
plot3d(H5, "Cyl5", "bars3d", "#22cc88", "separate", 4)
plot3d(AVG, "Spline", "ribbon", "#33ccff", "separate", 5)

windX = input(0.0, "Wind Dir X", -1.0, 1.0, 0.1)
windY = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -1.0, 1.0, 0.1)
windZ = input(1.0, "Wind Dir Z", -1.0, 1.0, 0.1)
windSpeedIn = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
maxSpeed = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
baseLen = input(10.0, "Base Length", 1.0, 30.0, 1.0)
stretchRange = input(20.0, "Stretch Range", 0.0, 50.0, 1.0)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

flowPush = (close - open) / (close + 0.000001)
liftPush = (close - median(close, 5)) / (close + 0.000001)

x = windX + flowPush * 0.5
y = windY + liftPush * 0.5
z = windZ + 0.0

m = sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z)

nxRaw = x / (m + 0.000001)
nyRaw = y / (m + 0.000001)
nzRaw = z / (m + 0.000001)

nxPrev = nxRaw[1]
nyPrev = nyRaw[1]
nzPrev = nzRaw[1]

nx = nxRaw
ny = nyRaw
nz = nzRaw
if m < 0.000001 {
    nx = nxPrev
    ny = nyPrev
    nz = nzPrev
}

yawDeg = nx * 90.0
pitchDeg = ny * 90.0
rollDeg = 0.0

speedMod = abs(change(close)) / (close + 0.000001) * 200.0
wind_speed_knots = windSpeedIn + speedMod

tRaw = wind_speed_knots / maxSpeed
t = tRaw
if tRaw > 1.0 {
    t = 1.0
}
if tRaw < 0.0 {
    t = 0.0
}

tailLen = baseLen + t * stretchRange

rChan = t
gChan = 0.3 + t * 0.2
bChan = 1.0 - t

arrowColor = "#004dff"
if t > 0.33 {
    arrowColor = "#7a4dff"
}
if t > 0.66 {
    arrowColor = "#ff8000"
}

dotProd = nx * nxPrev + ny * nyPrev + nz * nzPrev
validPrev = m[1] > 0.000001

highThresh = maxSpeed * 0.8
highWind = crossover(wind_speed_knots, highThresh)
calmWind = crossunder(wind_speed_knots, 2.0)
shiftWind = dotProd < 0.7071 and validPrev and m > 0.000001
shiftEdge = shiftWind and not shiftWind[1]

tipBar = baseLen + tailLen
tipPrice = close + pitchDeg * 0.2 + t * close * 0.05

arrow.new(0, close, tipBar, tipPrice, arrowColor, 2, "windarrow")

if highWind {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "triangledown", "#ff8000")
}
if calmWind {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Calm", "triangleup", "#004dff")
}
if shiftEdge {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Shift", "diamond", "#ff8000")
}

plot(wind_speed_knots, "Wind Speed Knots", "#ff8000", 2, "separate")
plot(tailLen, "Tail Length", "#004dff", 1, "separate")

plot3d(wind_speed_knots, "Wind Speed", "trail", "#ff8000", "separate")
plot3d(tailLen, "Tail Length", "line3d", "#004dff", "separate", 1)

if highWind {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "conedown", "#ff8000", markerSize, 2, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if calmWind {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Calm", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 2, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if shiftEdge {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Shift", "diamond", "#ff8000", markerSize, 2, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
